title: SEKA Spear Frameset (Standard) official store page
notes: Global store product titled Spear Frameset, the Standard frame sold separately from the Spear RDC Frameset, at USD 2,201 in seven finishes (Currant Black, Achromatic Silver, Twilight Blue, Borealis Blue, Cosmic Beige, Mint Green, Frosty Blue) and sizes XS–XL including MR and LR; several options were in stock. The description repeats the Wind Eye and True-One-Piece moulding features. Gallery photos show frame, fork, seatpost and Rapier bar only, not a dealer complete build; global price and stock do not establish mainland checkout.
